Modi and Xi discuss Global South roles at BRICS summit

At the BRICS summit, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi proposed a roadmap for reforming the bloc and called for a reset in global governance. Chinese President Xi Jinping told Modi that India and China hold 'significant responsibilities' as powers within the Global South. Modi stated that trust in BRICS is growing across the Global South, with voices being heard and solutions being crafted.
